test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The simple interest on a sum of money in 6 years at the rate of 15% per annum is Rs. 1,440 less than the simple interest accrued on the same sum in 9 years at 18% per annum. What is the sum of money (in Rs.)?
solution:
Given:

Interest difference = Rs. 1440,

T = 6 years and 9 years,

R = 15% and 18%

Formula Used:

A = P + (P × R × T)/100

Calculation:

Let the principal be P.

According to the question,

1440 = [(P × 18 × 9)/100] - [(P × 15 × 6)/100] 

⇒ 1440 = 162P/100 - 90P/100

⇒ 1440 = 72P/100

⇒ P = 2000

**The answer is 2000.**
